channel.title: The Steve Wilkos Show
channel.desc: Tekela discovers that $5,000 is missing from her account, and suspicion falls on her best friend of 13 years, Ma'Shawnda, who knows her bank login and was seen on her phone; after marrying on the New York City subway, Esmy now believes Daniel's friendship with Penny is more than "just work" and fears the two have been sneaking around behind her back; longtime friends Jasmine and Gwennesha face a major rupture after Gwennesha's ex says he slept with Jasmine.
